identity_filter: KOAD career-aware same-person filter; source keep and an explicit true_paper decision for the same researcher and work are both required before bibliography, affiliation, career, yearly, and journal aggregation; publication_year>=phd_year-5 when PhD year is known
bachelor_display_rule: institution only; no timeline estimate because leave/military and other gaps are unobserved
pre_doctoral_hard_gate: works and affiliations earlier than phd_degree_year-5 are duplicate_drop_candidate
same_institution_postdoc_rule: post-PhD same-institution affiliation period with work_count>0 before first faculty appointment
postdoc_recovery_rule: medium-confidence postdoc rows require strictly retained same-institution work evidence inside the recorded interval
same_institution_segment_merge_rule: same researcher, stage, and institution with at most two missing half-years is coalesced

manual_verified_patch.rule: externally verified works (Google Scholar profile / mapping review) added work by work; same selection, identity-year and lead rules as the full build

manual_career_patch.rule: pre-faculty postdoc segments from retained same-institution work evidence (medium confidence)

manual_namesake_patch.rule: career-consistency namesake rule (career_consistency.py): works without a career institution and with fewer than two coauthors shared with career-anchored works

manual_namesake_patch_bulk.rule: career-consistency namesake rule v2 (career_consistency.py): outside the subject home domains, fewer than two coauthors shared with career-anchored works, and a field (one shared) or subfield (none shared) absent from those works

manual_explicit_patches.rule: explicit keep: mathematics papers only (OpenAlex ID merged with namesakes from other fields)

manual_career_conflict_patch_bulk.rule: career-conflict rule (career_consistency.career_conflict): during a doctoral or faculty segment (more than a year from any boundary) the authorship names only other universities or hospitals (not in the lineage of the career institutions) and shares no coauthor with career-anchored works, or one while the subfield is absent from them
